messages:
aisha.docs: Heads up — I opened a docs PR that rewrites the region compatibility matrix and updates the data residency callouts. It also touches several SDK snippets. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6212 :eyes:

matt.engineering: Taking a look now. Quick Q — do we want to keep the old per-country footnotes or replace them with the new condensed matrix?

lina.i18n: prefer condensed matrix + a small footnote for special cases (HK/TW/BR). Translations team can backfill keys after merge.

sanjay.prod: Agree with condensed. Also flagged that the sample cURL in the PR uses the old region header name (X-Region) — needs to be X-Redwood-Region per runtime change last month. Broke a few examples elsewhere.

matt.engineering: Good catch. I can patch the snippet. Suggestion: add a short migration note for Dedicated vs Hosted endpoints and an example mapping table.

aisha.docs: Yes please. I added a TODO in the PR. If someone can add the tiny mapping table and update the SDK snippets (python/js) that'd be great. We should also call out the residency opt-in flag for on-prem customers.

lina.i18n: I'll queue translation keys after we freeze the copy. For the SDK snippets, here's the minimal python header example I want used across docs — small, copy/paste friendly:

```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="$REDWOOD_API_KEY", region="eu-west-1")
# explicit region header (new):
resp = client.generate("Translate this", headers={"X-Redwood-Region": "eu-west-1"})
print(resp.text)
```

matt.engineering: I'll update js and curl snippets to match. Quick JS pattern:

```js
const r = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY, region: 'ap-southeast-1' })
await r.generate('hello', { headers: { 'X-Redwood-Region': 'ap-southeast-1' } })
```

kate.legal: Quick flag — in the data residency note we should not say "all data stays in-region". Please use the phrasing from legal playbook: "where feasible, customer data is stored in the selected region; see residency SLA for exceptions." I can paste exact phrasing if helpful.

aisha.docs: Thanks Kate — please paste the exact line and I'll swap it in. Want to avoid legal follow-ups.

kate.legal: Pasting: "Redwood makes commercially reasonable efforts to store customer-controlled data in the selected region. See the Data Residency SLA for applicable exceptions and retention details."

sanjay.prod: Nice. Also found one broken link in the PR to the residency SLA (404). I created a tiny redirect in the site config — but can someone fix the absolute link in the PR to point to /legal/data-residency-sla/ ?

matt.engineering: I'll patch link and snippets in a follow-up commit. Will also add a one-line migration note: mapping old header X-Region -> X-Redwood-Region and example curl.

pr-bot: Preview site for PR #6212 published: https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.com/6212 — staging content includes matrix, snippets, and the draft migration note. :information_source:

lina.i18n: Great. After merge I can open a small task for translations (approx 12 keys). ETA 2 business days.

aisha.docs: Plan for merge: Matt to push snippet/link fixes today, Kate approves legal copy, Lina will queue translations post-merge. If anyone else wants to review the matrix logic (country -> region mapping) ping me and I'll add you as reviewer.

matt.engineering: Pushed fixes in commit 3f9a1b4, updated curl/js/python, fixed link. Leaving one question inline about Brazil special case.

lina.i18n: Commented on the Brazil row — we should mark it as "partial residency" and add footnote.

kate.legal: Approved legal copy. :white_check_mark:

aisha.docs: Thanks all — merging after CI passes. Will follow up with a short release note and a docs-changelog entry. :shipit:

pr-bot: PR #6212 merged by aisha.docs — preview removed, live doc updated at /docs/regions/compatibility-matrix/

matt.engineering: Verified snippets render correctly on live site. One tiny lint nit in code block formatting, I'll tidy in a follow-up.

sanjay.prod: I'll add a quick internal note in the runbook about the header rename so SREs know to expect the new header in traffic.

lina.i18n: Translation task created: DOCS-1987. Will start after keys available.

aisha.docs: Closing thread — thanks everyone. If any bugs appear, reply here or file an issue and tag @aisha.docs. :pray:
